node.title: Search hash keys using values from array
node.author: AhmedABdo
node.doctext:
Hi dear all
Assuming I have this array and hash. My @array = qw(world today is nice); my %hash = (0 => "Hello", 1=> "world" , 2=> "today" , 3=> "is" , 4=> "nice" ); I want to search thought the hash values using the array elements as values and then print the hash keys for each searched value from the array in a new array.
It should print 1 for world, 2 for today, so on which will be saved in the new array
I tried to use lookup with loop thought the array but it did not work.
I used grep also, but did not hot what I want
Any idea about how I can do it???
Thanks in advance
